links.text:
Introducing Modern Claudefare

Built fully with Opus 5 on High Mode over a few days using principles from @mattshumer_’s Gauntlet Loop - 84,100 lines of code

Includes remakes of 4 beloved maps:
0:00 - Rust
0:40 - Highrise
0:57 - Nuketown
1:26 - Terminal

Solo & multiplayer (w/ voice chat), bots included

Tools used:
- @threejs as core Javascript 3D library (all 20 guns and 4 maps generated by the model in code)
- @MeshyAI for 3D models + rigging + animations of 8 soldiers, 1 helicopter (highrise) and 1 bus (nuketown)
- @ElevenLabs for 430+ SFX, Music & TTS generations

Play it now at http://modernclaudefare.com

(More details in thread)

links.title: Modern Claudefare — Free Browser FPS Multiplayer
links.description: A fan-made Modern Warfare tribute that runs in a browser tab. Team Deathmatch, Free-for-All, four maps, bots, and four-player online multiplayer with voice chat.
